Audience: every first-time Nevada Basic Class C applicant; insurance and record rules apply from the first day of driving.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the minimum coverage and crash-reporting rules are exact legal values [A01], and the demerit point threshold decides when a license is suspended [A03].
Level: recall of exact dollar amounts, deadlines and point values with a few confusable form names; low conceptual load.
Prerequisites: none beyond sec01 licensing basics.
